name: viggle-h3
description: Viggle H3 is a multimodal video generation model optimized by Viggle based on MiniMax H3. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first- and last-frame control, and reference-to-video generation, with native audio output.
zhDescription: Viggle H3 是 Viggle 基于 MiniMax H3 优化提供的多模态视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧控制及参考生视频，并可生成带原生音频的视频内容。
longDescription: Viggle H3 is a multimodal video generation model optimized by Viggle based on MiniMax H3. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first- and last-frame control, and reference-to-video generation, with native audio output.
zhLongDescription: Viggle H3 是 Viggle 基于 MiniMax H3 优化提供的多模态视频生成模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧控制及参考生视频，并可生成带原生音频的视频内容。
extInfo:
{"exampleCodes":{"MiniMax":[{"code":"import json
import os
import urllib.request

url = "https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v2/video_generation"
payload = {
    "model": "viggle-h3",
    "quality": "low",
    "content": [
        {
            "type": "text",
            "text": "一只橘猫在窗边缓缓转头，柔和晨光，镜头稳定。"
        }
    ],
    "resolution": "768P",
    "duration": 5,
    "ratio": "16:9"
}
request = urllib.request.Request(
    url,
    data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["API_KEY"],
    },
    method="POST",
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=600) as response:
    result = json.load(response)

print("task_id:", result["task_id"])
","sectionTitle":"","name":"python"},{"code":"curl 'https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v2/video_generation' \
  --max-time 600 \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  --data '{
  "model": "viggle-h3",
  "quality": "low",
  "content": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "text": "一只橘猫在窗边缓缓转头，柔和晨光，镜头稳定。"
    }
  ],
  "resolution": "768P",
  "duration": 5,
  "ratio": "16:9"
}'","sectionTitle":"","name":"curl"}]},"supportedParametersDefaultValue":{"quality":"low","mode":{"text":{"enable":true},"firstFrame":{"enable":true,"attachments":{"image":{"formats":["JPEG","JPG","PNG","WEBP","HEIC","HEIF"],"maxSizeMB":30,"minCount":1,"maxCount":1,"roleType":"first_frame"}}},"firstAndLastFrame":{"enable":true,"attachments":{"image":{"formats":["JPEG","JPG","PNG","WEBP","HEIC","HEIF"],"maxSizeMB":30,"minCount":2,"maxCount":2,"roleType":["first_frame","last_frame"]}}},"example":{"enable":true,"attachments":{"image":{"formats":["JPEG","JPG","PNG","WEBP","HEIC","HEIF"],"maxSizeMB":30,"minCount":0,"maxCount":4,"roleType":"reference_image"},"video":{"formats":["MP4","MOV"],"maxSizeMB":100,"minCount":0,"maxCount":1,"roleType":"reference_video","required":{"resolution":{"minWidth":64,"minHeigh":64},"durationLimit":{"min":2,"max":15},"totalDurationLimit":15}},"audio":{"formats":["MP3","WAV","M4A","AAC","FLAC","OGG","MP4"],"maxSizeMB":15,"minCount":0,"maxCount":1,"roleType":"reference_audio","required":{"durationLimit":{"min":2,"max":15}}}}}},"duration":{"supported":true,"min":5,"max":15,"default":5},"resolution":{"supported":true,"options":["480P","768P","2K"],"default":"768P"},"ratio":{"supported":true,"options":["21:9","16:9","4:3","1:1","3:4","9:16","adaptive"],"default":"16:9"},"desc":"1. 基础能力
   - 支持文生视频、首帧图生视频、首尾帧图生视频、多模态参考生视频
   - 支持原生音频生成，可结合参考图片、视频和音频引导创作
2. 图片要求
   - 格式: JPG、JPEG、PNG、WEBP、HEIC、HEIF
   - 大小: <=30MiB/张
   - 尺寸: 大尺寸图片会自动等比缩放后处理
   - 数量: 首帧最多1张、尾帧最多1张、参考图片最多4张
3. 参考视频要求（可选，最多1个）
   - 时长: 2~15秒
   - 尺寸: 宽高均不小于64px，且必须为偶数
   - 大小: <=100MiB/个
   - 格式: MP4、MOV等可正常解码的视频格式
4. 参考音频要求（可选，最多1个）
   - 时长: 2~15秒
   - 大小: <=15MiB/个
   - 格式: MP3、WAV、M4A、AAC、FLAC、OGG、含音轨的MP4
   - 必须同时提供至少1张参考图片或1段参考视频
5. 输出参数
   - 分辨率: 480p / 768p / 1080p / 2k / 4k，必填
   - 宽高比: 21:9、16:9、4:3、1:1、3:4、9:16，支持adaptive自适应
   - 时长: 5~15秒，仅支持整数，必填
   - 质量: low（快速生成）/ high（完整质量），必填
6. 特殊约束
   - 提示词必填，每个text项最多7000字符
   - 首尾帧模式必须同时提供1张首帧和1张尾帧，不支持仅尾帧输入
   - 首尾帧图片不能与参考图片、参考视频或参考音频混用
   - 文生视频必须指定具体宽高比，不能使用adaptive
   - 首帧及首尾帧生成按首帧自适应比例；参考生成默认adaptive，也可指定具体比例
   - 请求体总大小不超过80MiB，大文件建议通过可下载URL传入。"}}
